psscan_missing_page.cause: Filtering creates a hole; stock PsScan propagates the missing-page exception while checking an invalid candidate. The first candidate is rejected in full RAM, not a demonstrated lost valid task.
psscan_missing_page.product_action: Document the limit; no neighboring-page expansion, zero filling, new options or analyzer modifications.

limitations: Reference full RAM uses the development full-RAM mode of the same collector; this does not independently validate its acquisition engine.
Projection applies the release PFN policy to the full-capture ledger, then copies selected bytes without rereading RAM. Retained payload hashes were checked.
Original live flags and memory are sequential, not atomic. The separate production capture occurred later.
Default empty plugin output does not demonstrate successful detection or a clean system.
Initial LA57 guest failed stock four-level translation even with full RAM; a manual five-level walk read the correct banner. The main comparison uses four-level paging.
